svg.title: SEP clock domains
svg.desc: The SEP top-level block diagram with its clock domains shown as tinted zones. The SEP clock clk_i, which the SMU drives from clk_smu_i, clocks everything inside the SEP boundary except three regions: the watchdog counter runs on clk_wdt_i, the reference counter in the system peripherals runs on clk_ref_i, and the TRNG noise sampler in the crypto subsystem runs on entropy_rosc_sample_clk_i. Each of these clocks enters the SEP as an arrow in the colour of its zone. The CPU debug TAP runs on jtag_tck_i, which arrives with the JTAG port. The quad SPI serial clock is divided from clk_i inside the SPI host.
